customManagers.description: The .NET SDK pinned in mise (Renovate's mise manager does not update dotnet); comment lines may sit above it

packageRules.description: Ship the .NET SDK (global.json and mise.toml) in the same PR as the NuGet packages
The Aspire CLI pinned in mise resolves the AppHost build's bundle (ASPIRE009) and pairs with the Aspire.Hosting.* package version, so it moves in the same PR as them
